rateLimits.note: MPC FAQ: "Please limit queries to https://data.minorplanetcenter.net/api/ endpoints to not more than 5 requests per second"; beyond, HTTP 429; a blocked IP is unblocked through a General Support ticket.

provenance.notes: Read 2026-11-10: the MPC FAQ. "Data from the MPC's database is made freely available to the public"; no licence, terms of use or attribution requirement stated (the FAQ credits NASA PDCO grant 80NSSC22M0024 for funding). The API index page states no policy. Rights unknown beyond free public availability.
